description: This file defines a utility for parsing assistant text with embedded tags such as <think> and <final>. It includes structures for representing text segments and methods for extracting, filtering, and analyzing these segments from raw input strings.

classes.name: AssistantTextSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of assistant text, categorized as 'thinking' or 'response', with a unique identifier and associated text.

methods.name: segments(from:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Parses raw input text into an array of AssistantTextSegment objects, optionally including 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: visibleSegments(from:)
methods.description: Returns only the visible (non-thinking) segments from the input text.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Checks whether the input text contains any visible content, considering 'thinking' segments based on the includeThinking flag.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:)
methods.description: Checks whether the input text contains any visible content, ignoring 'thinking' segments.
